identity.name: ROSCA Spin
principles: Fusion: Swiss Precision meets Casino Thrill
Emotion: Security in data, Adrenaline in the spin
Zoom: Focus on the winner, focus on the balance
Negative Space: Don't clutter the money

headings.usage: Main page titles, widget headers, modal titles. Use tracking-tight for sizes > 32px.

body.usage: General text, data tables, form inputs.

mono.usage: Transaction IDs, cryptographic hashes, financial figures in tables.

rules: No jagged bottoms - stretch widgets to full height
Winner list is the Tall (col-span-4 row-span-2)
Use 'Glassmorphism' for overlays and result modals
Use 'Tracing Beam' borders for feature highlights

cards.dashboard: bg-card border border-border/50 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all

wheel.interaction: Must have sound effects and haptic visual feedback (shake) on spin end

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on dark mode backgrounds to prevent banding
visual_enhancers.decorations: Abstract geometric shapes (circles, triangles) floating in background of Spin page

hero_community.alt: Diverse group of happy friends celebrating
hero_community.usage: Landing page hero or 'Join Group' modal background

meeting_professional.usage: About page or 'How it works' section

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Spin Wheel' as a reusable component using Framer Motion for smooth physics.
Use 'sonner' for all toast notifications (e.g., 'Member Added', 'Spin Result').
Ensure the Dashboard follows the 'Control Room' grid layout - dense and data-rich.
The 'Spin Session' page must feel like a game - use the 'Electric & Neon' archetype colors there.
Use the provided image URLs for the landing page and empty states.
Strictly follow the spacing scale - do not be afraid of p-12 or p-24.
Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
Do NOT center align the app container.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays are encouraged.
